name: progressive-carousel
title: Progressive Carousel
description: An auto-playing image carousel: one large 16:9 slide with a caption fades to the next every few seconds, while four thin bars below fill to show progress and double as slide buttons.
use: A hero or gallery should cycle through a handful of images without visible arrows.
avoid: Auto-advance cannot be paused and there is no reduced-motion handling, so some users lose control.
a11y: The four bar buttons have no accessible names, the carousel auto-advances with no pause, and it ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A large rounded photo slide fills the top with a dark gradient at its base carrying a bold white title and a smaller subtitle. Beneath it runs a row of four thin, evenly spaced progress bars, the active one brighter than the rest.
behaves: The slide auto-advances every few seconds: the current photo fades out and the next fades in while the active bar fills from left to right. Clicking a bar fast-forwards to that slide.
customise: Duration, initial slide and vertical mode are props on ProgressSlider; slide order and count come from the children you pass, while bar colours are className edits.
weight: moderate: A requestAnimationFrame loop updates progress every frame plus a fade animation per slide.
